annotations.title: Draft a CaseMail message for approval

description: Write a CaseMail message from a saved case's address and return a link the user opens to review and send it. Use when the user asks you to reply to case correspondence or to write to someone about the case. Nothing is sent by this tool: the message only leaves CaseMagic after the user opens the review link and confirms it, and the link expires. Tell the user that they still have to confirm.

body.description: The message body, as plain text.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

name: send_case_mail

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

sent.description: Always false: the message is drafted for the user to approve, never sent by this tool.

title: Draft a CaseMail message for approval
